text:
```yaml
name: Gemini Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  gemini-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get PR diff
        id: diff
        run: |
          git diff ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} > pr.diff
          echo "diff_size=$(wc -c < pr.diff)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Review with Gemini
        if: steps.diff.outputs.diff_size > 0
        uses: google-github-actions/gemini-code-review@v1
        with:
          api_key: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          model: gemini-2.5-flash
          diff_file: pr.diff
          prompt: |
            You are an expert Rust developer reviewing a pull request.
            Please review the changes in the provided diff.
            Focus on:
            1. Correctness and potential bugs
            2. Performance implications
            3. Idiomatic Rust usage
            4. Security concerns
            5. Code style and readability
            
            Provide concise, actionable feedback.
            If the code looks good, say so briefly.
            If there are issues, list them clearly with line references if possible.
```
